# Draft:Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty

| last_aired        =
}}
Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty (Chinese: 唐朝诡事录, Táng Cháo Guǐ Shì Lù) is a Chinese historical mystery and suspense television series adapted from the novel of the same name by **Wei Fenghua**. The drama combines period‑set detective investigation with supernatural elements and court intrigue in Tang Dynasty China. It debuted on the Chinese streaming platform iQIYI in September 2022 and has expanded into a multi‑season franchise.
Premise
The series follows investigators such as **Lu Lingfeng** and **Su Wuming** as they tackle strange and unexplained cases in and beyond the Tang capital of Chang’an. The narrative interweaves mystery, suspense, and historical context, as the protagonists unravel baffling cases while contending with political and supernatural elements.
Production
The first season was released on iQIYI in September 2022. The success of the franchise led to a second season, *Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty 2: To the West*, which debuted in July 2024 to widespread attention and chart success. A third season, *Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty 3: To Chang’an*, began filming in late 2024 under a co‑production between iQIYI and **G.H.Y Culture & Media Holding’s Tianjin Changxin Film & Media** and was completed for broadcast in 2025.
Series overview
Season 1 (2022)
Season 1 introduced the core characters and world, establishing the detective‑mystery tone that defined the series.
Season 2: *To the West* (2024)
Released in July 2024, *To the West* continued the adventures of Lu Lingfeng and Su Wuming. The series topped multiple summer drama charts in China with a content popularity index exceeding 10,000 on iQIYI and earned strong audience ratings.
Season 3: *To Chang’an* (2025)
Premiering on November 8, 2025, *To Chang’an* features 40 episodes and brings the investigative team back to the Tang capital. The season explores new strange cases within Chang’an and expands the narrative scope of the franchise.
Cast
* **Yang Xuwen** as *Lu Lingfeng* — Lead investigator in the Tang capital.
* **Yang Zhigang** as *Su Wuming* — Skilled detective and partner to Lu Lingfeng.
* **Gao Siwen** — Supporting role in ensemble cast.
* **Chen Chuang** — Cast member in the series.
* **Sun Xue Ning** — Appears in later seasons.
* **Yue Li Na** — Featured in the series.
Reception
Season 2’s strong ratings and high content popularity index demonstrated the franchise’s appeal within China’s competitive streaming market, contributing to the IP’s broader expansion, including VR experiences based on the series.
